subject: WRITE statement
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 14.9.51.4 'The same WRITE statement without the FROM phrase' -> OK 5) b)): WRITE ... FROM is equivalent to MOVE identifier-1/literal-1 TO record-name-1 followed by the WRITE. Code: both emitters start with `if (wr.FromMove is { } fromMove) move.Emit(fromMove);`, which emits the BOUND implicit MOVE built by the binder under the MOVE screens (kb/Work PB348), and then emit the plain WRITE. Probe dir: out/probe/write-statement-p3/ (pinned adj-d1 cobol.exe). from1.cob: FROM WS-SRC 'HELLO' into X(8) gives 'HELLO   '; FROM "LIT" gives 'LIT     '; FROM S9(3) -42 gives '042     ' (the MOVE rule for a numeric integer sent to an alphanumeric item: the unsigned magnitude, left-justified); FROM group WS-GRP gives 'GG07    '; FROM ALL "Z" gives 'ZZZZZZZZ'; an indexed WRITE K-REC FROM WS-KSRC is stored as 'K01DATA1'. pb348_from_into_move_rules (85/2002/2014/2023 legs) is spec-derived and pins the identifier arm against an explicit MOVE+WRITE pair; the literal arm is witnessed only by the probe.
